description: This source file defines an abstract base class 'BaseLLMAdapter' for integrating various Language Model Provider (LLM) adapters. It specifies the interface and some common logic for converting to provider-specific formats, handling messages, and managing LLM invocation parameters. It is part of a system that standardizes interactions with different LLM providers.

classes.name: BaseLLMAdapter
classes.description: An abstract base class for LLM provider adapters, providing a common interface and some shared logic for converting tool schemas, extracting messages, and handling provider-specific invocation parameters.

methods.name: str id_for_llm_specific_messages(self)
methods.description: Abstract property to get the identifier used in LLMSpecificMessage instances for this LLM provider.

methods.name: TLLMInvocationParams get_llm_invocation_params(self, context: LLMContext, **kwargs)
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve provider-specific invocation parameters from a universal LLM context.

methods.name: List[Any] to_provider_tools_format(self, tools_schema: ToolsSchema)
methods.description: Abstract method to convert a standardized ToolsSchema into the provider-specific tool format.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] get_messages_for_logging(self, context: LLMContext)
methods.description: Abstract method to extract messages from the LLMContext in a format suitable for logging.

methods.name: LLMSpecificMessage create_llm_specific_message(self, message: Any)
methods.description: Creates a LLMSpecificMessage instance for use in the LLMContext.

methods.name: List[LLMContextMessage] get_messages(self, context: LLMContext)
methods.description: Retrieves messages from the LLMContext, including standard and LLM-specific messages.

methods.name: List[Any]|NotGiven from_standard_tools(self, tools: Any)
methods.description: Converts tools from standard format to provider-specific format if necessary, with fallback.
